messages:
sam_sourcing: Zenith just sent a firm partial allocation: 32 H100s, ETA ~6-8 weeks, but with a freight surcharge. They want +$6k/GPU for air expedite or +$2k/GPU for sea with split AWB. quote attached: https://vendorzenith.example/quote/ZN-4821
kevin_provisioning: Is that +$6k on top of our current committed price or total?
erin_ops: They said "surcharge on top" in the email. i.e., add to PO unit price. also flagged 2 units as DOA historically in their batch notes — says RMA pool applies.
jordan_logistics: If we accept air for full 32 that bumps shipping ~$192k. customs in NL will add brokerage ~€1k per pallet. For EU edge customers we care about lead time; otherwise sea is much cheaper but delays 3–4 weeks.
vendor_zenith: Confirming: surcharge is incremental. We can split shipment: 8 air (expedite) + 24 sea consolidated. For DOA we will accept returns to our NL repair hub; we need AWB and photos within 24h of failure to start RMA. We can also offer 4 loaner units for 2 weeks at no extra cost while RMA clears.
sam_sourcing: Loaners available? that helps. proposal: take 8 expedited (cover critical EU pools), 24 by sea. Accept +$6k for 8, +$2k for the rest. Need finance signoff.
maria_finance: quick calc: incremental freight uplift ~ $6k*8 + $2k*24 = $48k + $48k = $96k. plus customs/brokerage ~ €8k. budget wise we can cover up to $100k from contingency this quarter, but procurement needs to confirm PO term.
kevin_provisioning: Also note capacity-wise we have two Dedicated clusters on-call for hot pool. If those 8 arrive earlier we can reassign reservations. I can change rollout to pin on the new hardware.
erin_ops: RMA flow: if DOA rate > 3% we open a vendor dispute. vendor_zenith, can you confirm historical DOA for this SKU and SLA for replacement?
vendor_zenith: Historical DOA ~1.8% across last 3 shipments. Replacement SLA: 5 business days from receipt at NL hub for refurbished swap, 10 business days for new replacement if stock available. We will escalate priority for expedited AWBs.
jordan_logistics: For the split AWB route we'll need separate invoices and HS code confirms (8473.30.1000) — customs may request supplier value explanation. Also suggest marking the 8 expedited as "urgent for infra" on AWB to push customs clearance.
kevin_provisioning: Decision needed: do we approve PO with split shipments and the surcharge? Also confirm RMA routing to NL hub + loaners.
sam_sourcing: My recommendation: approve the split (8 air / 24 sea), accept surcharges as vendor proposed, require loaners for the 8 expedited units, and add a clause: if DOA rate >3% across the shipment, full credit + pickup at vendor expense. Maria ok with that?
maria_finance: OK on contingency for this, but need a line item in PO for the surcharge and a cap: max exposure $120k. Also want vendor to provide proforma invoice with detailed freight lines.
erin_ops: I'll add the RMA acceptance clause to the PO template and add the NL hub address + contact. also create a provisioning ticket to pin 8 slots.
vendor_zenith: We'll send updated proforma + AWB templates by EOD. AWB for the 8 will be provisional until packing. photos & serial list will be shared prior to dispatch.
kevin_provisioning: I'll draft PO and send to legal/procurement for sign. tagging ops for the routing: @erin_ops can you confirm loaner handoff procedure once units land?
erin_ops: yes — loaner flow: 1) vendor ships loaners with separate AWB 2) we register serials in temp pool 3) swap timeline 2 weeks 4) vendor collects DOA units (we provide pickup LRD) I'll paste the template in #eng-sre later.
rma-bot: Reminder: create RMA ticket for incoming shipment ZN-4821 when AWB is assigned. Use template: `RMA-ARRIVAL-<AWB>` for tracking. auto-assign to jordan_logistics + erin_ops.
sam_sourcing: Great. action items: kevin to raise PO with surcharge line + cap; vendor to send proforma & AWB; erin to update RMA clause + provisioning ticket. I'll update the allocation sheet after PO sent. Thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin_provisioning: on it. will post PO draft here when ready.
vendor_zenith: Will aim to ship the 8 expedited within 10 business days after PO, sea for the rest within 14 days.
erin_ops: noted. I'll monitor DOA trend once units land and escalate if >3%.
sam_sourcing: Closing thread once PO confirmed.
